_comment: Mutation testing for the client voting engine — the frontend half of what mutmut does for fast_api_voter (.github/workflows/mutation-testing.yml runs both). Scoped to src/lib/playgroundVoting.ts: it carries the project's thesis (the rule decides the winner) and is one of the two files locked by the engine-parity harness. Non-blocking until two real runs give us a defensible thresholds.break — see the plan's chantier 4b.
